changes.old: On 9 July 2026, BRG made a remedy offer to the ACCC of a court-enforceable undertaking pursuant to s87B of the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (the Act), which requires that On 9 July 2026, BRG made a remedy offer to the ACCC of a court-enforceable undertaking pursuant to s87B of the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (the Act), which requires that BRG must divest, including by procuring divestiture, either the Northern Road bottle shop, the Royal 99 bottle shop, or both, to an ACCC-approved purchaser before they may complete the Acquisition (the remedy offer).
